name: International Comics Festival "Salon stripa"
blurb: Serbia's biggest comics event, held each autumn at Belgrade's Student Cultural Center with international comic artists.
notes: Official site's newest content is still the 'comics-festival-2024' section (guests link points there) and carries no announced 2026 or 2027 dates; JSON-LD and date snippets are empty. Site text says the festival runs 'during the last week of September (from Thursday to Sunday)' most years, so a 2027 edition is likely around late Sept 2027, but nothing is confirmed yet. WebSearch (Serbian-language press: danas.rs, stripblog.in.rs) only surfaced coverage of the 19th/20th editions (2022-2023), nothing for 2025, 2026 or 2027, so left editions empty rather than guess.
